title: Excursión to Humantay Lake Full Day from Cusco
overview: This Humantay Lake Full-Day Tour from Cusco is a great pick for visitors who want to see the lake but only have a day to spare. This full-day tour takes visitors to the lake through the Soraypampa Trek, which is a circular route that runs about 2.7 miles (4.3 kilometers). A guide knows the best spots to stop at to see wildlife and teaches about the sacred mountains surrounding the area, too.
startDescription: Hotel pickup is listed for hotels in the Cusco city center.

title: Rainbow Mountain Trek from Cusco with Breakfast & Lunch -Full Day
overview: Travel for a few hours from Cusco through the rugged mountain countryside of Peru to reach the aptly named Rainbow Mountain, striped with colorful mineral deposits and located far off the beaten path. Hike with a guide to the summit, or rent a horse (own expense) for easier access to the same views. Entrance to the mountain is not included.
startDescription: Exact hotel pickup time is provided 24 hours before travel. Drop-off is at Plaza Regocijo, one block from the central plaza.

title: Cusco City Tour Four Ruins Half-Day Tour
overview: Many visitors to Cusco rush through the city on the way to Machu Picchu. But the ancient capital of the Incas deserves more time. This half-day, small-group tour takes visitors to Cusco's most-important landmarks, including the main square and the temple of Coricancha, as well as the nearby ruins of Sacsayhuaman, Qenko, Puca Pucara, and Tambomachay.
inclusions: Hotel pick up and drop off in Cusco City Center
startDescription: Meet at Triunfo, Cusco 08002, with hotel pickup listed for the city center.

title: Sacred Valley of the Inkas Full Day Tour
overview: Visit the top five attractions in Peru’s Sacred Valley on a group tour from Cusco. All-inclusive transportation enables a single day covering Ollantaytambo, Moray, Chinchero, Pisac, and the Salinas de Maras salt mines. Along the way, lunch and a visit to a craft workshop in colonial Chinchero are listed.
startDescription: Hotel pickup is listed from Cusco hotels on the published morning departure.

title: Full-Day Rainbow Mountain Adventure with ATV
overview: Peru’s Rainbow Mountain is usually explored on a challenging hike that reaches high altitudes. This small-group excursion uses an all-terrain vehicle so the group can spend more time on the colored slopes and local wildlife rather than a long uphill walk. Breakfast and lunch are included.
startDescription: Hotel pickup is confirmed at booking for the published Cusco departure.

title: Cusco by Night: Planetarium Cusco, Dinner, and Pisco Sour
overview: See a different side to Cusco on a nightlife tour that includes dinner and a drink. In an intimate group limited to eight people, the evening covers stargazing at Planetarium Cusco, illuminated landmarks in the historic center, and a traditional Peruvian dinner accompanied by a Pisco Sour cocktail. Hotel pickup and drop-off are included.
startDescription: Hotel pickup and drop-off are included. Planetarium entrance is listed separately on the product page.

title: Experience the Magic of Andean Textiles: Weaving workshop - Cusco
overview: In the heart of Peru’s Sacred Valley, this dyeing and weaving textile workshop is led by master weavers who show natural-dye and loom techniques. Lunch is served family-style with the artisans, and coffee or herb tea is included. Hotel pickup by private transport is offered. The group is capped at five.
startDescription: Private hotel pickup is listed for the published Cusco departure.

title: Full Day Tour to Machu Picchu From Cusco
overview: This full-day Machu Picchu outing from Cusco includes a pre-departure briefing, round-trip train tickets between Ollantaytambo and Machu Picchu, admission tickets, and the bus between Aguas Calientes and the citadel. Transport to the train station from Cusco is listed both ways. The published format is private for the booked group.
inclusions: Transport to the train station from Cusco
startDescription: Transport to the Ollantaytambo train station from Cusco is included both ways after a pre-departure briefing.

title: 2-Day Tour: Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu by Train
overview: Discover the Sacred Valley and Machu Picchu on this 2-day tour. Visit key sites such as Pisac, Urubamba, and Ollantaytambo and discover their archaeological sites with a guide. Spend the night at Aguas Calientes, the village at the base of Machu Picchu, and rest before the citadel visit the next day. Breakfast, accommodations, and round-trip transport by bus and train are included.
inclusions: Hotel pick up and drop off
startDescription: The 2-day itinerary starts with pickup in Cusco. Door-to-door service is listed if no road restrictions apply.

title: Machu Picchu Private Full-Day Tour from Cusco
overview: This private full-day tour from Cusco includes a train ride through the Sacred Valley, a buffet lunch, and a private tour of the UNESCO-listed archaeological site. The published route covers the Temple of the Sun and the Sacred Plaza. Hotel pickup and drop-off are included. The private format keeps the group on one party.
inclusions: Private hotel pickup and drop off
Private transport from hotel to train station
Professional English or Spanish speaking guide
startDescription: Private hotel pickup in Cusco and private transport to the train station are included.
